        "The complete 28-path diff was read, including all removed local mock implementations and their actual caller substitutions. The shared factory is exported as a testing module. The only production change removes the Calendar location handler and its lazy import at this historical revision; accepted source has an explicit handler again. Do not infer the reason for either change without its full discussion.",
        "The shared mock has two mutually exclusive loadURI observation paths. A pending promiseLoad receives uri.spec and does not append urls. Repeated promiseLoad calls before arrival return the same pending promise, not one promise per caller.",
        "reset clears URL history and rejects pending promise but leaves the factory registered. cleanup first asserts history is consumed, restores the original class registration, then resets. Two migrated offline notification test cleanup hooks call reset only; the selected accepted second-run test retains that distinction. This is not evidence that reset is sufficient to restore the service.",
        "Message click helper calls become awaited and synthetic user clicks replace element.click. Existing sequential-click lesson is reused. Other mock consumers replace URI equality checks with counts or awaited completion only; those checks do not prove the right target URL unless a separate URL assertion remains. No tests were executed and no native browser launch was exercised.",
        "Parsed 41 changed historical Assert calls in JS test files with no parse failures. Four newly introduced equal calls have no expected-behavior message: Calendar location, two notification end-to-end URL results, and notification telemetry count. The three assertions in the new shared helper all have nonempty should messages. Receipt records exact calls and argument positions. No missing-should-only defect is reported.",
        "The mock isExposedProtocol hardcodes protocol names and does not read preferences. Its comment says match current prefs, but the later 3025 EWS preference addition is not in this regex even in fixed source. Do not use this test stub as an exhaustive production protocol policy or infer platform handler capability from externalProtocolHandlerExists=false.",
        "Full Bug 1972727 description/comments 0–4 and D254634 creation-to-landing timeline read. Bug rationale is consolidation of many external-protocol mocks. Logical grouping should keep registering the wait, the click and the resulting assertion together; this narrow reading does not establish a formatting rule."
